acceptance: Candidate is v0.5.0rc2: make release-prep VERSION=0.5.0rc2 from the current develop tip folds the never-published [0.5.0rc1] section into [0.5.0rc2] (designed behaviour; do not restore rc1), the curated section passes --check-curation (at most 45 bullets and 160 lines), the prep PR merges, and its merge commit has a successful trunk push run. Do not reuse v0.5.0rc1: merged commit 18165fad2 also carries 0.5.0rc1 with a green trunk run and an unexpired dist artifact (expires 2027-01-18), so an rc1 tag there would pass admission on identity checks.
The owner creates and pushes the annotated tag v0.5.0rc2 on that merge commit (owner action); no tag is created by an agent

From the release-v2 run, recorded here: TestPyPI file hashes equal the admitted SHA256SUMS; all 12 install-matrix cells (including the bundled SQLGlot runtime smoke) and the artifact-bound release UAT pass; attestations verify against release-v2.yml; one Linux install from the TestPyPI index with --no-deps (dependencies from PyPI) imports 0.5.0rc2

Refusal paths: tests/unit/scripts/test_release_artifact_consumer.py, test_release_admitted_dist.py and test_release_artifact_execution.py pass on the tagged commit, and one workflow_dispatch with an invalid tag shape fails in admit. Live lightweight-tag, hash-mismatch and expired-artifact probes are dropped: the v-tag ruleset blocks deleting a probe tag, a hash mismatch cannot be induced without tampering with a real artifact, and an artifact cannot expire inside its 90-day retention
GizmoSQL stays in the candidate (owner decision 2026-10-27); no revert of #3358 and no restore item
context:

PR #3172 already made release-v2 tag-triggered and release.yml dispatch-only. release-v2 has zero runs; package is 0.5.0rc1. The old rc2 prep worktree BenchBox.wt-release-prep-rc2 and branch chore/release-prep-0.5.0rc2 were deleted on 2026-10-27 at the owner's instruction; the unreachable local commit baae5fc1 holds that draft (base a9cafd11f, GizmoSQL excluded, runtime 30.24.0.13, rc1 restored by hand), so use it only as wording reference.

2026-10-28 review (session 01a17d41): the owner's 2026-10-27 release handoff names v0.5.0rc2 as the rehearsal tag; acceptance now says rc2 for that reason and because 18165fad2 stays admissible as v0.5.0rc1. Scratch rehearsal on develop ac41876bc (local clone, nothing pushed): release_flow check --version 0.5.0rc1 passed (SQLGlot freshness now passes on fork 30.25.0.1 from #3587; advisories, curation, uv.lock revision and dependency bounds pass). release_flow prep --version 0.5.0rc2 exited 0: [0.5.0rc1] and its compare link removed, [0.5.0rc2] link is v0.4.2...v0.5.0rc2, [Unreleased] stays v0.4.2...HEAD, changelog.d left with README.md only; check --pre-tag then fails only on the ceilings (204/45 bullets, 333/160 lines). Prep dates the section with the local date. Retry path after a failed release-v2 run: a fix confined to release-v2.yml can be retried with workflow_dispatch from develop and the same tag input, because every job checks out the tagged commit for scripts and configs; a script, config or content fix needs a new prep PR and a new rc tag. The release UAT job (three release-gate sweeps on one ubuntu-latest runner, 360-minute limit) has never run on a hosted runner; the first rc2 run is that evidence. Open owner decisions before the prep merge: (1) hold merges on develop from the prep PR's final CI run until its trunk run finishes, since any new changelog.d fragment fails the pre-tag check; (2) whether a flaky trunk run on the prep merge commit may be re-run before tagging (the recorded guardrail forbids re-runs only on the tagged commit, and the artifact consumer admits only the latest successful attempt).
description:
AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

Split from dlv2-52 by the 2026-10-17 adversarial review (codex Required + claude NEW: F9(3) as tracker split). This item owns only the TestPyPI rehearsal; it does NOT need dlv2-22. The real PyPI release stays in dlv2-52, which needs this item plus dlv2-22.

Preconditions (decision gates, all must hold before tagging):
- dlv2-51 merged; release-v2 runs as workflow_dispatch with a tag input during the overlap (legacy release.yml keeps its v* tag trigger until the first new-path PyPI release; see dlv2-51).
- Owner has registered PyPI and TestPyPI trusted publishers for the release-v2 workflow file name, or the rehearsal records invalid-publisher as its blocker (claude NEW-2). No agent may register publishers.
- Rehearsal version uses the repo form 0.5.0-rc.1 (tag v0.5.0-rc.1, annotated with git tag -a). scripts/update_version.py:201 rejects 0.5.0rc1. Existing tags are lightweight (v0.4.2 peels to commit; scripts/release_finalize.py creates tags without -a) and the consumer refuses lightweight tags, so the annotated form is mandatory (claude NEW-1).
- CHANGELOG [Unreleased] duplicate Added/Changed/Fixed sets are merged in this item's rc release-prep PR, not deferred to the final prep (claude F8).

Steps: make release-prep VERSION=0.5.0-rc.1, merge, wait for green trunk push run on the merge commit, create annotated tag, dispatch release-v2 to TestPyPI, compare published hashes with the admitted SHA256SUMS, install from TestPyPI on every T4 cell. Decide and record the rc-prep side effects before running prep: docs version markers will advertise the rc and the final 0.5.0 notes cover only changes since the rc (claude NEW-9). Record the decision in context.

Guardrails: never rebuild artifacts; never fall back to an older trunk run; no trunk reruns on the tagged commit (a rerun changes admitted hashes, claude NEW-7); pre-release tags route to test-pypi only; stop and report if any required gate fails.
